name: mistif
description: Claude Code kit in one plugin: workflow skills (interview, build, test, review, ship, design, decide, prompt), and the hud, effort, explain, lean, ask-first and agents-pane mods

handoffSkill.title: Handoff skill (optional)
handoffSkill.description: A skill or slash command that writes the Full handoff, e.g. session-handoff. Empty: mistif writes it itself (checks git, saves HANDOFF.md). Quick is always a fast fork with the built-in prompt.

handoffAfter.title: After a handoff (first choice)
handoffAfter.description: What the handoff does once it is written. The chat is never cleared without asking: continue and confirm ask first (then clear; confirm waits for you in the new chat); copy keeps the chat and copies the handoff.

effortBias.title: Effort slider
effortBias.description: -2 cheaper to 2 smarter. Tips the judge's close calls that way; sure calls stay. 0: as the judge says.

effortFloor.title: Never below
effortFloor.description: Auto never picks a lower effort than this.

effortCeiling.title: Never above
effortCeiling.description: Auto never picks a higher effort than this.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: full: nothing added. lite: one short line in the system prompt (inline or one agent, no peer review, short outputs, no fan-out unless asked) and the skills take their short path.

contextCheck.title: Context check
contextCheck.description: on: once a chat passes about 30% of its context, a few recent messages go to Haiku to suggest a fresh chat. off: that call is never made.

hide.title: Switched off
hide.description: Comma-separated: timer (the cache countdown), reason (the judge's line), line (the effort after each reply on the terminal). the hud mod draws the footer and its own alerts.
